analysis.intent_details: Sending job alerts for front end developer positions in Karachi

responses.subject: Re: Full Stack Developer at The Madesigners and 3 more front end developer jobs in karachi for you!
responses.body:
Dear Indeed Team,

Thank you for the job alert. I have received the notification regarding 4 new front end developer positions in Karachi, including the Full Stack Developer role at The Madesigners.

I will review these opportunities and consider applying to suitable positions.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A professional acknowledgment shows courtesy while confirming receipt of the job alert. This maintains a good relationship with the job platform.

responses.subject: Job Alert Confirmation - Front End Developer Positions
